# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 stable release** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 delivers Skia m150 with new filtering APIs and managed performance improvements. It adds quick bounds, crop, empty, and overdraw filters while updating the bundled HarfBuzz engine.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — Brings the bundled renderer forward with upstream m150 fixes. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **New culling and image-filter controls** — Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds plus crop, empty, and overdraw color and image filters. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271), [#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228), [#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface canvas access is more efficient** — Caches the managed canvas wrapper returned by SKSurface to reduce repeated wrapper allocations. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine to 14.2.1.
